title: Centre de Commandement Premium
subtitle: Outils avancés de planification, simulation, organisation et automatisation construits à partir des informations déjà détenues par votre club.
premiumOnlyBody: Free managers keep the complete game and manual control. Premium adds deeper analysis, simulations, saved workflows and smart prefills without improving race-engine strength.
scopeBody: Staff Briefing Centre is the coin-based, staff-role advisory system: selected employees proactively interpret training, health, race programme, equipment or scouting. Premium Command Center does not replace those advisors. It provides deterministic dashboards, simulations, scenario tools, templates and user-controlled automation that do not depend on staff skills and do not send advisor reports.

preview.headline: Run the same club with much better information, planning and organisation.
preview.body: Free managers keep the complete game and manual control. Premium adds scenario tools, simulations, saved workflows and smart prefills. It never boosts race-engine strength, rider development or transfer acceptance.
preview.whyTitle: Why this does not replace Staff Briefing Centre
preview.whyBody: Staff Briefing Centre remains the separate coin-based staff advisory product. Your selected Head Coach, Sports Director, Doctor, Mechanic or Scout proactively interprets their own area and generates role-specific reports. Premium Command Center is a deterministic workspace: dashboards, simulations, scenario tools, templates and user-controlled prefills that do not depend on advisor skills.

features.strategyDesc: Compare visible rider suitability and race-profile scenarios before you commit your official plan.
features.seasonDesc: See races, deadlines, sponsor targets and preparation gaps across the next part of your season.
features.transfersDesc: Put shortlist, saved searches, market alerts and live negotiations into one transfer pipeline.
features.financeDesc: Test transfers, wages and planned spending without changing your club balance.
features.sponsorsDesc: Track objective progress, deadlines, remaining targets and risk bands in one place.
features.developmentDesc: Follow development trends and recent progression instead of seeing only the current rating.
features.templatesDesc: Save your own management presets and automatically match them to known contexts.

summary.title: Premium Command Summary
summary.subtitle: Operational signals from your existing club data. This is not a staff advisor report.
summary.noPriority: No high-priority operational signals are currently detected.
summary.seasonPreparationHint: races currently showing a deadline or preparation gap
summary.deadlineClose: Start-list or preparation deadline is close. {{saved}}/{{total}} stage plans saved.

strategy.title: Race Strategy Lab
strategy.description: Compare rider suitability against the known stage profile before changing the official race plan. This is an on-demand simulation workspace, not the coin-based Sports Director advisory.
strategy.scoreNote: The suitability score uses visible skills, stage profile, fatigue and morale. Aggression is kept as a scenario note and does not change the official race plan.
strategy.smartPrefillDesc: Match one of your own saved race-strategy templates to this stage profile.
strategy.noRule: No enabled Smart Prefill rule matches this stage yet.
strategy.selectPreparation: Select an upcoming race preparation to open Strategy Lab.

season.title: Season Planner
season.description: One planning timeline for the next 60 game days. It combines existing race preparation, deadlines, sponsor-target links and saved stage-plan coverage. It does not replace the Sports Director advisor's proactive race-program reports.
season.noUpcoming: No upcoming race preparations are currently scheduled.

transfers.title: Transfer Command Center
transfers.description: Organise the transfer workflow in one place. The Scout Advisor remains a separate coin-based source of proactive scouting interpretation.
transfers.savedSearchesHint: Premium searches with optional market alerts

finance.title: Financial Simulator
finance.description: Run a non-destructive what-if scenario. Nothing entered here posts a transaction or changes your club.

sponsors.title: Sponsor Intelligence Center
sponsors.description: Progress, remaining target and deadline risk are calculated from your existing sponsor-objective data. No advisor role or Staff Advisory purchase is used.
sponsors.none: No active sponsor objectives are available right now.

development.title: Rider Development Lab
development.description: Follow recorded development over the latest eight-week window while keeping current rider skills available to every manager. This is historical analysis, not a Head Coach advisory report.

templates.title: Templates & Smart Prefill
templates.description: Save your own management choices and let Premium match them to a context. Smart Prefill never silently changes an official race plan, training plan or equipment setup. It selects your preset for you; you remain in control of applying the final gameplay action.
templates.name: Name
templates.equipmentNote: Equipment templates are created directly from your current owned setup on the Equipment page, so they always store real equipment IDs rather than placeholder selections.
templates.ruleExample: Example: when terrain_type = hilly, preselect your “Hilly Classic” race template in Strategy Lab.

training.title: Premium Training Templates
training.description: Prefill your saved training choices without changing anything automatically. Review the draft and use the normal Save buttons.
training.none: No training templates saved yet. Create one in Premium Command Center.
training.appliedTeam: Premium template “{{name}}” prefilled the team-default drafts. Review and save each team when ready.
training.noRule: No enabled Premium Smart Prefill rule matches {{rider}}.
training.matched: Smart Prefill matched “{{name}}” for {{rider}}. The draft was updated only; save it if you want to apply it.
training.failed: Premium Smart Prefill could not be checked.

equipment.title: Premium Equipment Templates
equipment.description: Save the current draft as a reusable setup, or use Smart Prefill to select one of your own templates for a terrain context. Nothing is applied until you press the normal Save Default Setup button.
equipment.applied: Premium template “{{name}}” prefilled the default setup draft. Review it and press Save Default Setup to apply it.
equipment.saveFailed: Could not save Premium equipment template.
equipment.noRule: No enabled Equipment Smart Prefill rule matches terrain_type = {{terrain}}.
equipment.prefillFailed: Could not run Equipment Smart Prefill.

overview.title: Premium Command Summary
overview.gateDescription: Premium turns existing club data into a deterministic management workspace with planning, simulations and saved workflows. Staff Briefing Centre remains the separate coin-based staff-advisor system.
overview.subtitle: A deterministic management snapshot built from information your club already owns. It does not create staff-advisor reports and does not replace the coin-based Staff Briefing Centre.

riderProfile.title: Premium Rider Development Lab
riderProfile.subtitle: See this rider inside the club-wide development view without replacing the Head Coach's coin-based advisory reports.
riderProfile.body: The Development Lab compares recorded progression across your whole squad. It is historical analysis, not a staff-advisor recommendation.
